info.title: Clikgate API
info.description:
Clikgate API: links, routing and attribution.

Authenticate with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer cg_live_...`), an OAuth client
credentials token from `POST /oauth/token`, or a dashboard user token plus the
`Clikgate-Organization` header. Send `Clikgate-Mode: live|test` to choose the environment with a
dashboard token, and an `Idempotency-Key` header to retry a `POST` or `PATCH` safely. Lists use cursor
pagination (`limit`, `starting_after`, `ending_before`); errors share one `{"error": {...}}` body.

get.description: The link's QR code (or a QR placement's with `placement_id`) as SVG, PNG or print-ready PDF. It encodes the link with its QR ending (`?qr=1` on the plain link is still counted as a scan). Design: a saved `style_id` (Growth and up), else the organisation's default style, then the inline overrides; colours on every plan, logo, shape, frame and label from Starter. Rules are checked first (`422` with the rule's `code` and `fix`), then **every** code passes the server scan check at full size, small print and blurred (`422 qr_scan_check_failed` with `tests` and `reasons`).

EarningRuleSchema.title: EarningRuleSchema
EarningRuleSchema.description:
Valid combinations: `first_counted_goal` with `once`; `every_counted_goal` with `once` or `days`.
`percent` needs a payment goal (confirmed amounts). `id` keeps an existing rule (a changed rule gets a new
version; earnings keep the version they were made under).

`reward_type` `money` (default), `credit` (store credit: `amount` or `percent`, tiers and
product rates as for money) or `gift` (`gift_name`, optional `gift_value`; fixed only: `pay: fixed` and no
`amount`, tiers or product rates). `cost_to_us` (credit and gifts) is what one reward costs the business (default:
the credit amount or the gift value; may be lower), used only for cost per new customer. A credit rule's
`cost_to_us` goes with a fixed `amount` (tiers and product rates scale it in proportion).

reason.description: Why it isn't counted. `received`: `not_counted_yet` (the name isn't set up yet) or `goal_archived`. `waiting`: `waiting_for_confirmation` or `pending_click`. Not counted: `already_counted_for_click`, `outside_window`, `rejected_bot`, ... Refused (422, final: never retry): `unknown_goal` (the organisation refuses goal names that aren't set up, live only), `goal_archived`, `payment_goal_needs_confirmation`, or another error code.

tags.description:
> **Use the Clikgate SDK instead.** These endpoints are documented for platforms we don't have an SDK for yet. The SDKs handle install IDs, retries, offline queues, consent, deep link timing and fraud checks for you; calling these endpoints yourself can count installs wrongly, miss attribution, or get your app's traffic flagged as suspicious. Use an `cg_sdk_test_*` key until your integration passes "See it live".
>
> [See the SDKs](/docs/sdks) · [Request an SDK](/docs/sdks#request-an-sdk)
